ModMetaData.name: Automatic Outfit Manager
ModMetaData.author: tekmojo
ModMetaData.description:
Set outfits and access permissions for Work and Non-Work Areas. Pawns wear the required apparel and one selected primary weapon before entering a Work Area, then return borrowed outfits and restore personal gear. Use Non-Work rules for dining rooms, lounges or bedrooms: prefer saved personal outfits, choose fallback gear, and decide which Work outfits to remove.
Optional locker rooms, successful-task buffers and managed storage filters keep outfits organized. Map-area colors, concise activity hovers and editable rule descriptions make rules easier to follow. Hover a badge to highlight its area; click to center the map. Deleting a rule asks for confirmation.
Supports vanilla and modded apparel and primary weapons. Rules are configured by the player; AOM does not choose outfits from detected hazards. Animals and robots follow access permissions without changing outfits. Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony. Quiet, Basic and Detailed logging are available in mod settings.
